about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Admitted to the sacred banquet, O Lord, we have drawn water in joy from the Savior’s fountain; may His Blood, we beseech You, become for us a fountain of water springing up unto life everlasting. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: salt, salt down, preserve with salt
